reason: I already pay for vidIQ and use half of it, so another tool needs to prove itself before I add ₹299 a month. I would sign up for the free version and see whether Mitra's weekly suggestions match what my own numbers show before paying anything.
objection: I don't yet believe an AI manager can understand my channel well enough to give advice worth more than what I already get from vidIQ and my own analytics.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it correctly predict which of my videos would beat my usual views, in Hindi, for a few weeks on the free plan, with the reason shown from my own data.
